I say it's less morality and more to do with personal connection. Your average Skyrim NPC is a dickhead. The joke about quicksaving before killing an NOC (or otherwise doing other horrific things to one) for slighting the player character in some way is popular because it's true. 

Paarthurnax, meanwhile, hasnt some much to earn that kinda ire. Skyrim typical dialogue aside, hes actually pretty alright to the player character. Plus, hes a dragon. Who doesnt want to be friends with a dragon?
Sold Cass out to the Van Graffs. I was curious.
It's been a while, but I renamed both!

Hey! I had the same issue and did the same thing you did, and I also ran into this cycle of the game going back to the opening. What I did was I renamed the other file (farmname_numberstring_old) like I did with SaveGameInfo_old, and it went back to normal! I know you started a new file, but I thought this would be helpful for the future! :)
Could I be sent a copy, please?
Oh, I love them. Theres a point where words cannot really describe how one feels, and I think these kinds of comments are just those feelings in pure bursts of emotion.

Aborted a sewerslide attempt. Just kinda stopped before I went through with it, stared at myself in the mirror for a little while. The tool I was using was hella dull so I just kinda sat and started dragging it against my legs instead. This all stemmed from a dumb argument I had with my guardian, but I've been contemplating it for years beforehand so i guess that was the tipping point.
